title: Beyond State-Wise Mirror Descent: Offline Policy Optimization with Parametric Policies
abstract: arXiv:2602.23811v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate the theoretical aspects of offline reinforcement learning (RL) under general function approximation. While prior works (e.g., Xie et al., 2021) have established the theoretical foundations of learning a good policy from offline data via pessimism, existing algorithms that are computationally tractable (often in an oracle-efficient sense), such as PSPI, only apply to finite and small action spaces. Moreover, these algorithms rely on state-wise mirror descent and require actors to be implicitly induced from the critic functions, failing to accommodate standalone policy parameterization which is ubiquitous in practice. In this work, we address these limitations and extend the theoretical guarantees to parameterized policy classes over large or continuous action spaces. translated_title: 超越逐状态镜像下降：基于参数化策略的离线策略优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在一般函数逼近下离线强化学习（RL）的理论问题。尽管先前的工作（如 Xie et al., 2021）已通过悲观原则确立了从离线数据中学习良好策略的理论基础，但现有在计算上可行的算法（通常在 oracle 高效的意义上），例如 PSPI，仅适用于有限且较小的动作空间。此外，这些算法依赖于逐状态的镜像下降，并要求策略执行者（actor）从评论者（critic）函数中隐式导出，因而无法适应实践中普遍存在的独立策略参数化方式。在本工作中，我们解决了这些局限性，将理论保证扩展到大动作空间或连续动作空间上的参数化策略类。在将镜像下降扩展到参数化策略时，我们识别出上下文耦合是其中的核心难点，并展示了如何通过将镜像下降与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该工作将离线强化学习的理论保证从有限小动作空间扩展到大/连续动作空间上的参数化策略类，识别出将镜像下降推广至参数化策略时的核心难点“上下文耦合”，并据此提出了计算上高效（oracle高效）的独立参数化离线策略优化算法。
en_tdlr: This work extends the theoretical guarantees of offline RL to parametric policy classes over large or continuous action spaces, identifies contextual coupling as the core difficulty in generalizing mirror descent to parametric policies, and yields oracle-efficient offline policy optimization algorithms with standalone policy parameterization.
